description: The agent must: (1) Locate the OFD file at `incoming_documents/2024/Q1/procurement_notice_2024.ofd`. (2) Discover the pre-existing skill scripts at `scripts/ofd_to_text.py` and `scripts/ofd_to_markdown.py` — NOT write its own OFD parser. (3) Run `python scripts/ofd_to_text.py incoming_documents/2024/Q1/procurement_notice_2024.ofd procurement_notice_2024.txt` to produce the plain-text output. The proprietary trap: the agent must understand OFD is a ZIP with XML content in the `http://www.ofdspec.org/2016` namespace (this knowledge is in SKILL.md), and that the existing scripts handle this correctly. (4) Run `python scripts/ofd_to_markdown.py incoming_documents/2024/Q1/procurement_notice_2024.ofd procurement_notice_2024.md` to produce the Markdown output. (5) The resulting .md file must contain: Markdown table syntax (`| col | --- |`) with the procurement data (A001, 激光打印机, 3500 etc.), AND heading syntax (`## 第一条...`) for the chapter headings detected by the heuristic heading-detection logic. A generic agent that tries to build its own ZIP/XML parser will likely fail on the namespace-aware element iteration, or fail to replicate the table/heading detection logic from the existing scripts.
